_comment: Test-write policy for this project, read by @hooks' test-write gate (schema: aipass.hooks apps/modules/testgate_policy.py; read it live with drone @hooks testwrite). Stamped by @spawn at the project's first seat; the owner's file from then on.
note: The owner flips this per project. "off" refuses agents creating NEW test files under any tests/ folder, the same refusal a missing file gave, now ruled and named here; editing existing tests stays allowed. "on" lets agents create tests in this project. While off, allow[] lists seat names let through.
